strings.d1.s0.name: The Bund
strings.d1.s0.tips: A row of colonial buildings with Pudong opposite; locals practise tai chi in the morning, and it's free of crowds.
strings.d1.s1.name: Nanjing Road East
strings.d1.s1.tips: China's busiest pedestrian street; stop at Shanghai First Food Store.
strings.d1.s2.name: People's Square & Shanghai Museum
strings.d1.s2.tips: Bronze and porcelain collections; free entry, reserve with your passport.
strings.d1.s3.name: Yang's Fry Dumplings
strings.d1.s3.tips: Shengjianbao (pan-fried soup dumplings); Huanghe Road, bite and sip technique.
strings.d1.s4.name: Bund Gece Manzarası
strings.d1.s4.tips: Pudong lights 19:00-22:00; a Huangpu river cruise (~120 CNY) is optional.
strings.d1.b0.name: Jia Jia Tang Bao
strings.d1.b0.tips: The xiaolongbao legend; Huanghe Road, closes early.
strings.d1.b1.name: Huangpu River Cruise
strings.d1.b1.tips: Night river cruise; an alternative to the Bund.
strings.d2.theme: Yu Garden and the Old City
strings.d2.s0.name: Yu Garden
strings.d2.s0.tips: Classical Ming-dynasty garden; quiet at the 08:30 opening, with a zigzag bridge.
strings.d2.s1.name: Yuyuan Bazaar
strings.d2.s1.tips: A bazaar around the garden; souvenirs and tea.
strings.d2.s2.name: Nanxiang Mantou Dian
strings.d2.s2.tips: Where xiaolongbao was born, since 1900; sit-down upstairs, takeaway with a queue downstairs.
strings.d2.s3.name: City God Temple
strings.d2.s3.tips: Taoist temple in the middle of the bazaar.
strings.d2.s4.name: Tianzifang
strings.d2.s4.tips: Workshops and cafes in shikumen alleys; French Concession.
strings.d2.b0.name: Lin Long Fang
strings.d2.b0.tips: Local xiaolongbao; French Concession, no tourists.
strings.d2.b1.name: Huxinting Teahouse
strings.d2.b1.tips: Teahouse above the Yu Garden lake.
strings.d3.s0.name: Shanghai Tower Top of Shanghai
strings.d3.s0.tips: 118th floor, 632 m; clear air in the morning, and the world's fastest lift.
strings.d3.s1.name: Lujiazui Pedestrian Bridge
strings.d3.s1.tips: From the circular bridge you see the Oriental Pearl and the towers.
strings.d3.s2.name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
strings.d3.s2.tips: 155 m underwater tunnel; good with children.
strings.d3.s3.name: Din Tai Fung Pudong
strings.d3.s4.name: Century Park
strings.d3.s4.tips: Pudong's huge park; lake and cycling.
strings.d3.b0.name: Shanghai Grandma Pudong
strings.d3.b0.tips: Local Shanghai cuisine; hongshao rou (red-braised pork).
strings.d3.b1.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
strings.d3.b1.tips: Retro pink tower; an alternative to Shanghai Tower.
strings.d4.s0.name: Wukang Road
strings.d4.s0.tips: Plane-tree-lined avenue and Wukang Mansion; art deco villas and cafes.
strings.d4.s1.name: Propaganda Poster Art Centre
strings.d4.s1.tips: Mao-era posters in an apartment block basement; hidden and fascinating.
strings.d4.s2.name: Fu 1039
strings.d4.s2.tips: Shanghai cuisine in a 1913 villa; drunken chicken and red-braised pork.
strings.d4.s3.name: Xintiandi
strings.d4.s3.tips: Cafes in restored shikumen houses; the Museum of the First National Congress of the Communist Party is free.
strings.d4.s4.name: Fuxing Park
strings.d4.s4.tips: French-style park; retirees dance and play mahjong.
strings.d4.b0.name: Jesse Restaurant
strings.d4.b0.tips: The old Jesse; hongshao rou, book ahead.
strings.d4.b1.name: Shanghai Museum of Art Pudong
strings.d4.b1.tips: New museum opposite the Bund; an alternative to Xintiandi.
strings.d5.s0.name: Zhujiajiao Fangsheng Bridge
strings.d5.s0.tips: 1 hour on Metro Line 17; five-arch bridge built in 1571; go in the morning before the tour buses arrive.
strings.d5.s1.name: Zhujiajiao Canal Boat Tour
strings.d5.s2.name: Kezhi Garden
strings.d5.s2.tips: The town's classical garden; entry with a combined ticket.
strings.d5.s3.name: Zhujiajiao Canalside Restaurant
strings.d5.s3.tips: Zongzi (sticky rice dumplings) and pork trotters; riverside tables.
strings.d5.s4.name: Zhujiajiao Bei Dajie
strings.d5.s4.tips: Shops along the northern street; roasted chestnuts.
strings.d5.b0.name: Ah Po Cha Lou Zhujiajiao
strings.d5.b0.tips: Teahouse over the canal; dim sum.
strings.d5.b1.name: Qibao Ancient Town
strings.d5.b1.tips: Water town close to the city; a shorter alternative to Zhujiajiao.
strings.d6.s0.name: Humble Administrator's Garden
strings.d6.s0.tips: 25 minutes by high-speed train from Hongqiao; China's most famous classical garden, UNESCO-listed.
strings.d6.s1.name: Suzhou Museum
strings.d6.s1.tips: I.M. Pei's white-and-grey museum; free entry, reservation required.
strings.d6.s2.name: Pingjiang Road
strings.d6.s2.tips: Old street running along a canal; silk shops and teahouses.
strings.d6.s3.name: Pingjiang Road Noodle House
strings.d6.s4.name: Tiger Hill
strings.d6.s4.tips: Leaning pagoda and the tomb of the King of Wu; return train at 18:00.
strings.d6.b0.name: Songhelou Suzhou
strings.d6.b1.name: Shantang Street
strings.d6.b1.tips: Canal street; an alternative to Tiger Hill.
strings.d7.s0.name: Jing'an Temple
strings.d7.s1.name: Jing'an Kerry Centre
strings.d7.s2.name: Xiaoyang Shengjian Jing'an
strings.d7.s3.name: Maglev Longyang Road
strings.d7.s3.tips: Reach Pudong Airport in 8 minutes on the 430 km/h maglev; a fitting farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Wagas Jing'an
strings.d7.b1.name: Jing'an Sculpture Park
strings.d7.b1.tips: Sculpture park and the Natural History Museum.
strings.note0: Alipay and WeChat Pay work with foreign cards, and cash is rarely needed; the metro is cheap and extensive (3-7 CNY). The maglev reaches Pudong in 8 minutes.
strings.note1: Visa: in 2026 many countries get 30 days visa-free (check for Türkiye); set up a VPN beforehand for Google and WhatsApp.
strings.note2: Summer is 35°C and humid; typhoons occur in July and August. Do the Bund in the morning, museums and shopping centres in the afternoon, and Pudong's lights at night.
strings.note3: Xiaolongbao costs 30-50 CNY; go to Yang's for shengjianbao; brunch in the French Concession runs 100+.
strings.note4: Museums are free but need an online reservation with your passport; buy your Shanghai Tower ticket online.
strings.note5: No tipping; bargaining is expected in markets but not in shops.
strings.transit.name: Shanghai Public Transportation Card / Alipay
strings.transit.why_chosen: For metro and buses; the Alipay Transport code also works with foreign cards
